It is essential for resistance management to minimise the selection of resistance to any one type of pesticide, and this is best carried out by the use of alternations, sequences or rotations of compounds from different MoA groups. The Global Resistance Management application allows you search which active ingredients belong to which groups and should help you in the selection of treatments for effective and sustainable resistance management.
